reminder: Screening support only. A clinician decides.
prototype_note: Research prototype, not a medical device.
signin_body: Use the team account Nana Yaw gave you.
signin_failed: That email or password did not work. Check them and try again.
no_clinic: Your account has no clinic yet. Ask Nana Yaw to add you to the demo clinic.
backend_missing: This copy of the app is not connected to the team backend. Results will not be saved.
backend_required: This copy of the app is not connected to the team backend, so it cannot be used for screening. Tell Nana Yaw.
home_title: Screen a chest X-ray for TB
home_body: Photograph the film or upload the image. It takes about a minute.
model_ready: TB model ready on this phone
model_ready_body: Runs on the phone. The image is never uploaded.
model_demo: Demo stand-in loaded, not the TB model
model_demo_body: Results in demo mode are made up. Use it to try the screens only.
model_loading_body: This happens once. Keep the app open.
take_photo: Take a photo of the film
under15_title: This check is for people aged 15 and over
under15_body: Do not use it for children's X-rays. Follow your usual care for this child.
not_ready_pending: The team has not set the decision thresholds for this model yet, so the app will not show results.
not_ready_invalid: The thresholds file does not match this model. Tell Kweku before screening.
not_ready_model: The TB model could not be loaded or did not pass its file check. Tell Nana Yaw.
checking_body: Everything runs on this phone. The image is not uploaded.
retake_title_too_small: Retake: the image is too small to read
retake_body_too_small: Move closer so the film fills the frame, or upload the full-size image.
retake_body_blank: Make sure the whole film is in view and in focus, then take the photo again.
retake_title_too_dark: Retake: the image is too dark to read
retake_body_too_dark: Hold the film against a bright window or light box, then take the photo again.
retake_title_not_xray: Retake: this does not look like a chest X-ray
retake_body_not_xray: Photograph only the X-ray film, filling the frame, with nothing else in view.
retake_no_result: No result was made from this image.
error_body: The image could not be checked. No result was made. Try again with another photo.
message_refer_now: High risk on this scan. Refer for a TB confirmation test.
message_unsure: Not sure. Retake the image, or refer.
message_low_risk: Low risk on this scan. This does not rule out disease. If symptoms continue, test or refer.
refer_confirm: Refer for a TB confirmation test, following your clinic's process.
not_saved: Not saved to the team backend. The result above is unchanged.
monitor_title: Is the TB model still seeing what it was trained on?
monitor_none: No records yet. The first screening after deploy appears here. Each record holds numbers only: no image, no name, no patient ID.
monitor_failed: Could not load records. Check that you are signed in.
kpi_quality_note: too small, blank, too dark or not an X-ray
kpi_last_note: a silent feed is an alert too
score_ref_pending: Validation reference not loaded yet; live results only.
drift_formula: PSI = Σ (live − train) × ln(live ÷ train) over 10 bins. 0.2 or more is the alert line.
drift_pending: Training reference not loaded yet. Showing the live median instead of PSI.
drift_aspect_ratio_why: The shape shortcut found in training (ADR-16).
drift_edge_energy_why: Texture tracked the TB score in Shenzhen.
drift_mean_brightness_why: Photos of film against digital files; room light.
drift_width_why: An upstream format change, the stale-feed case.
zone_mix_note: A shift here with steady inputs points at the model or the thresholds, not the images.
